text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've achieved quite an unexpected
feat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on Seeking the Pearl's
journey
through the Classics...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on the Mile tour instead of
running the Japanese Oaks. It really
seems like mile races are
the best
distance for me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's take the Shuka Sho off my
schedule. That
path to the rest of the
world is no longer viable to
me anymore!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Remember how I said that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So then what are you?! The devil?! Some
kind of
sadistic demon?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you made me run the
entire Triple
Tiara! I got so invested in
the races too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And, heck, I ended up winning all of
them! I can
do anything if I try!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her achievement is nothing short of a
miracle,
and she was able to do it thanks
to her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl has shone blindingly
bright in
the Triple Tiara races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! It's party time! Gather around
and let's
celebrate, my friends!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Pearl... You're incredibly strong. I
couldn't
hold my own against you at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We ran in the Classic Triple Crown, so
we didn't
get to run together with you,
but yes, I agree with
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what she said! Well, I do better on
long,
winding tracks like the Kikuka Sho,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's okay for me to be here?
I didn't
leave much of a mark, after all...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! Now that the Classics are
over, the
battle between us is over.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now let's all talk about the youthful
memories
and experiences we had!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober, Mejiro Bright,
Matikanefukukitaru,
and Silence Suzuka
all raced together in their
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They celebrate their success happily,
and after
the party...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pearl? What are you doing over here all
by
yourself?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha... Isn't it all just so wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What is? Winning the Triple Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Not that. What's wonderful is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This world where anyone can go after
the Triple
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But it's a given that any Umamusume can
try for
the Triple Tiara if she wishes, is it
not?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It is... But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you can imagine a world where
things
aren't that way.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Maybe someone can't run in it because
of where they were born, and they're
blocked from
pursuing that path before
they even get to run...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a world or an era like that
exists
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You say some strange things sometimes,
Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But if a world or era like that does
indeed exist,
don't we simply have to try
to change things little
by little?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But if that revolution—if that
radical
change didn't happen in time...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We might not have been able to
compete in the
Triple Tiara together
either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we were born in this world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's an incredibly fortuitous
blessing
that's
even greater than winning the
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
How fantastic it is that we were born in
this world
where we can laugh and
compete alongside each
other.
